tasks.label: Prepare FULLPOS Windows Hot Reload
args: Get-Process fullpos,dart,flutter_tester -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; $nativeAssetsWin = Join-Path $PWD 'build\native_assets\windows'; $windowsBuild = Join-Path $PWD 'build\windows'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $nativeAssetsWin -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $windowsBuild -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0

tasks.label: Run FULLPOS Debug Windows
args: Get-Process fullpos,dart,flutter_tester -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; $nativeAssetsWin = Join-Path $PWD 'build\native_assets\windows'; $windowsBuild = Join-Path $PWD 'build\windows'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $nativeAssetsWin -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $windowsBuild -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & 'C:\src\flutter\bin\flutter.bat' run -d windows --debug
